'''Merr-Sonn Mil/Sci''' was a conglomerate known for being one of the original [[signatory sponsor]]s of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. They manufactured heavy weapons, [[Armor/Legends|armor]], siege equipment, and military gear. Subsidiaries included [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], [[MerrWeapons]], and [[Merr-Sonn Industrial Equipment]].<ref name="HSCS" />
